exams.name: Board of Registration in Optometry Examination
exams.notes: Covers theoretic, practical and physiological optics, theoretic and practical optometry, anatomy and physiology of the eye, and use of ophthalmoscope, retinoscope, perimeter, and other instruments.
exams.quote: shall practice optometry until he shall have passed an examination conducted by the board in theoretic, practical and physiological optics, in theoretic and practical optometry and in the anatomy and physiology of the eye

exams.name: Examination for Diagnostic Pharmaceutical Agents (Section 68A)
exams.notes: Required for certification to use diagnostic pharmaceutical agents under Section 66A. Includes any portion of the National Board of Examiners in Optometry examination covering pharmacology. Requires 95 hours of qualifying course of study.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Board of Registration in Optometry), incorporating National Board of Examiners in Optometry portions
exams.quote: Said examination shall be held in conjunction with the examination provided for in section sixty-eight and shall include any portion of the annual examination prepared by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry which covers the subject matter of pharmacology.

exams.name: Examination for Therapeutic Pharmaceutical Agents (Section 68B)
exams.notes: Required for certification to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents under Section 66B. Requires 90 hours didactic and 30 hours supervised clinical education.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Board of Registration in Optometry), incorporating National Board of Examiners in Optometry portions
exams.quote: shall include any portion of the examination administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry or other appropriate examination covering the subject matter of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents.

exams.name: Examination for Expanded Therapeutic Pharmaceutical Agents Including Schedules III-VI (Section 68C)
exams.notes: Required for certification under Section 66C to prescribe oral agents and treat glaucoma. Requires 40 hours didactic and 20 hours supervised clinical education, administered by Massachusetts Society of Optometrists, Inc.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Board of Registration in Optometry), incorporating National Board of Examiners in Optometry portions
exams.quote: The board of registration in optometry shall administer an examination to permit the use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as authorized in section 66C.

interval_years.quote: Every registered optometrist shall, annually, before February first, pay to the board a license fee

required.quote: Every optometrist registered under the provisions of this chapter shall, as a condition of continuation of his registration, present to the board, on or before February first in each year on such form as it may provide, evidence satisfactory to the board that in the preceding year he attended an educational conference or pursued an educational program within the commonwealth

available.quote: Any person who shall present to the board a certified copy or certificate of registration or license which was issued to him after examination by a board of registration in optometry in any other state, where the requirements for registration are in the opinion of the board equivalent to those of this commonwealth, may be registered and given a certificate of registration in this commonwealth without a written examination

requirements.value: Must present a certified copy of out-of-state registration issued after examination, requirements must be equivalent in the board's opinion, the state must accord reciprocity to Massachusetts holders, the applicant must not have previously failed the Massachusetts examination, must have practiced optometry continuously for at least 3 years immediately preceding application, and must intend to reside and practice in Massachusetts.
requirements.quote: provided, that such state accords a like privilege to holders of certificates of registration issued in this commonwealth, and that the applicant has not previously failed to pass the examination required in this commonwealth, and that he has been engaged in the reputable practice of optometry continuously for not less than three years immediately preceding his application, and that he intends to reside and practice optometry in this commonwealth.

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, prevention, correction, management or treatment of optical deficiencies, optical deformities, visual anomalies, muscular anomalies, ocular diseases and ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue, including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes, by utilization of pharmaceutical agents, by the prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids and the utilization of corrective procedures to preserve, restore or improve vision
definition_quote.quote: ''practice of optometry'' shall mean the diagnosis, prevention, correction, management or treatment of optical deficiencies, optical deformities, visual anomalies, muscular anomalies, ocular diseases and ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue, including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes, by utilization of pharmaceutical agents, by the prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids and the utilization of corrective procedures to preserve, restore or improve vision

drug_authority.value: Optometrists may use diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (topical anesthetics, mydriatics, cycloplegics) for examination purposes (Section 66A). Certified optometrists may use topical therapeutic pharmaceutical agents in Schedule VI (Section 66B). Optometrists certified under Section 68C may prescribe topical and oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents in Schedules III, IV, V and VI, including for treating glaucoma, but may NOT prescribe controlled substances by injection, agents for systemic disease treatment, opioids, or perform invasive surgical procedures.
drug_authority.quote: use and prescribe topical and oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as defined in section 66B that are used in the practice of optometry, including those placed in schedules III, IV, V and VI pursuant to section 2 of said chapter 94C, for the purpose of diagnosing, preventing, correcting, managing or treating glaucoma and other ocular abnormalities

surgery_prohibited.quote: nothing in this section shall be construed to permit optometric use of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents which are: ... (d) invasive surgical procedures.
